units.source_text: 每隔五天续弈，也是为了照顾名人的衰老病体，这显然招来了相反的结果。

en.t: Resuming the game every five days was also meant to take account of the Master's aging and ailing body, but it clearly produced the opposite result.

units.source_text: 假使双方充分使用自己享有的时间，合计得用八十个小时；

en.t: If both sides made full use of the time allotted to them, the total would come to eighty hours;

units.source_text: 以一轮对局约用五个小时计，鏖战十六轮，每隔五天一轮，

en.t: counting about five hours for each session, sixteen hard-fought sessions, one every five days,

units.source_text: 即使顺利进行的话，也需用三个月的时间。

en.t: would require three months even if everything went smoothly.

units.source_text: 一盘棋需要集中保持三个月的战斗情绪，总是那么紧张，

en.t: To sustain the fighting spirit for a single game over three concentrated months, always under such tension,

units.source_text: 对决定胜负时的心情来说也是过长了，这等于白白消耗棋手的精力。

en.t: was too long even for the state of mind needed to decide victory or defeat; it amounted to wasting the players' strength for nothing.

units.source_text: 对局期间，不论是睡是醒，胜负的形势总是在脑际盘旋。

en.t: During the match, whether asleep or awake, the state of the contest was always circling in the mind.

units.source_text: 中间即使安歇四天，与其说是休养，莫如说更增加了疲劳。

en.t: Even if there were four days of rest in between, it increased fatigue rather than serving as recuperation.
